text_simplified: A parent’s duty is not limited to providing food, drink, shelter, and clothing. The greater duty is to dedicate time to sit with his children, listen to them, and guide them with wisdom and kind counsel. Luqman the Wise combined in his counsel to his son monotheism, birr al-walidayn, mindfulness of Allah, establishing prayer, enjoining good and forbidding wrong, patience, humility, and lowering the voice.
